parameter-group.name: integrations
parameter-group.label: Integrations
parameter-group.description: Settings consumed by JSR223 rules that integrate the alarm bridge with house systems (push, TTS, email, badge readers). Toggle these globally here — bridge / zone / output Things have their own timing parameters in Settings → Things.

parameter.name: notificationsEnabled
parameter.label: Send Notifications
parameter.description: Master kill switch for push / TTS / email notifications emitted by alarm rules. Turn off during testing or maintenance.

parameter.name: unifiDisarmDenylist
parameter.label: UniFi Disarm Denylist
parameter.description: Comma-separated UniFi user names that may NOT disarm via badge, even if UniFi grants door access. Example: "Contractor-A, Cleaner". Leave blank to allow every UniFi user that UniFi itself authorizes at the door.

parameter-group.name: pins
parameter-group.label: PIN Management
parameter-group.description: PINs are managed as child Things of the bridge. Go to Settings → Things → AlarmPanel main → press + to add a PIN, or click an existing PIN child Thing to edit its label / toggle disabled / rotate the code. Power-user CRUD is also available from the Karaf console: openhab:alarmpanel pin list|add|remove|rename|enable|disable.

parameter-group.name: logs
parameter-group.label: Logs
parameter-group.description: The audit log is a JSON-lines file at /var/log/openhab/alarm-audit.log. The 5 most recent events are also surfaced as Thing Properties on the bridge (Settings → Things → AlarmPanel main → Properties → recent_event_1 …). Use the Karaf console for a tail: openhab:alarmpanel events [N].
